text:
Morgan: CI red for integration-tests on Buildkite (job #2345). Lots of failures hitting the mock broker used by kv tests. Anyone else seeing this?
ci-bot: Buildkite: integration-tests (linux, matrix) failed — 24 failing tests. Logs: https://buildkite.company/2345 (snippet below)
Priya: I spun up the suite locally with MOCK_KV=1 and see the same failures. Broker connection refused repeatedly.
Priya: ```
Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:9092
    at TCPConnectWrap.afterConnect (net.js:1144:16)
Caused by: mock-kv-broker: connection refused
```
Diego: I checked the CI host pool — one of the mock broker containers crashed and didn't restart. Restarted it manually: `./infra/scripts/restart-mock-broker --cluster=ci --service=mock-kv` :thumbsup:
Samir: Can someone run a bisect? Last green for that pipeline was around timestamp 1746122000. If it's infra, we should mark as environment flake.
Katy: Starting a quick bisect locally — will run `git bisect` against the infra changes from yesterday. Pushing a CI job for bisect as well.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by Priya for build 2345 — queued.
Priya: Rerun completed and the integration-tests are green now. Looks like the mock broker process was OOM-killed. From docker logs: `Status: OOMKilled` and then the container never came back up due to missing restart policy.
Priya: ```
Container mock-kv exited with status 137 (OOMKilled)
Memory usage: 1.9GiB / 2.0GiB
No restart policy set for this container in CI job definition.
```
Morgan: OK — not a code regression. Action items: (1) infra to add restart policy + healthcheck for mock services in CI, (2) increase memory for mock-kv containers, (3) add a fast healthcheck step in the pipeline so we fail fast when mocks are down.
Diego: Opening INFRA ticket INFRA-867 to add restartPolicy and liveness probes, and bump mem to 4Gi.
Katy: I'll add the CI healthcheck (simple TCP connect to 9092 with 5s timeout) in the pipeline config and a fallback wait-retry step.
Samir: Marking this as environment-related and closing the bisect. Not a regression in app code. @release-team fyi.
Morgan: Thanks all — glad rerun fixed it. Leaving ticket with infra for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
